entities.summary: Scott Sio is an Australian and Samoa rugby union player who plays for the Exeter Chiefs in the Premiership Rugby and is a former coach at Devon club Topsham RFC. His playing position is prop. He made his Brumbies debut during the 2012 Super Rugby season against the Sharks in Canberra.
